data.name: Bharini
data.long_meaning: A woman who carries the mountain on her head or shoulders. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bharati', meaning 'bringer of joy'. It is also associated with the goddess Parvati, who carried the mountain Kailash on her head.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of spiritual burdens and joys

This name also has ties to the goddess Parvati, who is known for her devotion, strength, and compassion.
